signals.entity: Hungarian Parliament / MNB — Act XVIII of 2025 as amended by Act XIV of 2026
signals.signal: PRIMARY LAW, MATERIALLY CHANGED: the consolidated text of Act XVIII of 2025 on ATM deployment is in force in a NEW version from 14/05/2026, amended by section 96 of Act XIV of 2026. Section 3(1)(a) now explicitly carves ATM REPLACEMENT ('ide nem ertve az ATM csereret') out of the ban on decommissioning existing ATMs, and new subsections 3(1a)-(1c) were inserted: a relocated ATM must stay inside the same settlement/Budapest district; if a like-for-like swap is technically impossible at a site (size, physical-security requirements of the NEW machine), the replacement ATM may only be installed elsewhere in the same settlement; 'justified' relocation is defined as moving to an ATM-less settlement, demonstrable average withdrawal volumes, or landlord termination of the site lease. Section 2(6) sets the escalating fine ladder in law: HUF 5m after 3 months of non-compliance, then 10m / 20m / 30m / 50m / 75m / 100m / 150m at 3-month steps and HUF 200m after 30 months, on top of the base HUF 2m-200m penalty; the fines go straight to the central budget. Section 2(3) expressly permits payment service providers to install and operate ATMs JOINTLY without breaching competition law.
signals.source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabalytar / Hatalyos Jogszabalyok Gyujtemenye (net.jogtar.hu) — 2025. evi XVIII. torveny, consolidated text
signals.implies: The amended wording is a direct tailwind for Printec ATM/self-service and cash-recycler REPLACEMENT business in Hungary: banks are legally frozen from shrinking the estate but explicitly free to swap machines, and the law even anticipates that a NEW machine may be physically larger / have higher security requirements than the one it replaces — i.e. it contemplates recycler-class upgrades. The joint-installation clause opens shared/white-label ATM deployments (Printec managed services, ATM-as-a-service) for small settlements. The fine ladder gives banks a quantified cost of missing the 31/12/2026 phase-2 deadline.
signals.likelihood: Very high — the law is in force and the phase-2 deadline is 31/12/2026, four months away
signals.followup: Pull the current 19/2025 (VI.26.) MNB decree annex listing which bank must install in which settlement, and map Printec's Hungarian bank coverage against the residual 500-1,000-resident settlement list; approach MBH, OTP, Erste HU, Raiffeisen HU and Gránit with a joint/shared-ATM managed-service proposition.

signals.entity: Hungarian Parliament / MNB — Act XVIII of 2025 phase 2
signals.signal: STATUS OF OPEN BASELINE ITEM: the phase-2 obligation is unchanged and still live — every settlement above 500 inhabitants (2022 census) must have working ATM cash withdrawal by 31/12/2026. As of 31/08/2026 no Constitutional Court (Alkotmanybirosag) decision has been published on the November-2025 joint constitutional complaint by OTP Bank with Erste and Raiffeisen; the law remains fully in force and was amended (not struck down) in May 2026.
signals.source_name: net.jogtar.hu Act XVIII of 2025 consolidated text; Index.hu report on the constitutional complaint
signals.implies: No legal relief for the banks means the Q4-2026 ATM procurement/deployment scramble is on. Printec ATM hardware, site preparation, installation logistics and managed services all have a hard, dated demand window ending 31/12/2026.
signals.likelihood: High — deadline in four months and no judicial stay
signals.followup: Monitor alkotmanybirosag.hu for a decision; ask Hungarian banks directly how many of their allocated 500-1,000-resident settlements are still unequipped as of Q4.

Clusters: (a) SIX concurrent security/fraud roles — SOC Analyst L1, SOC Analyst L2, Vallalati biztonsagi szakerto (corporate security expert), Bankbiztonsagi szakerto, Bankbiztonsagi FRAUD MANAGEMENT szakerto, Medior serulekenysegmenedzsment szakerto (vulnerability management), plus a Penzmosas megelozesi szakerto (AML) and Compliance tanacsado; (b) the named agentic-AI build continues with AI Platform Architect, Senior Agentic Software Engineer, Data Science Advisor and Senior Solution Architect; (c) a core-banking seat, 'CBS - Domain Architect'; (d) 'Payment Product Manager' and 'Szamla termekmenedzser' (account product manager); (e) TWO strategic procurement roles — 'Szenior Strategiai Beszerzesi Szakerto - Contract Optimization & Vendor Strategy' and 'Strategiai beszerzesi tanacsado'. 'CBS - Domain Architect' signals core-banking-domain work that pulls channel integration behind it. The two vendor-strategy procurement roles are the commercial door: a bank formalising contract optimisation and vendor strategy is about to re-tender incumbent supplier contracts. signals.entity: Komercni banka + MONETA Money Bank + Air Bank + UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia
signals.signal: SHARED DEPOSIT-ATM NETWORK EXPANDED: UniCredit Bank joined the KB/MONETA/Air Bank shared cash-DEPOSIT ATM network in February 2026, taking it to nearly 1,000 deposit ATMs usable on the same terms as a customer's own bank and with no extra fee. All four banks unified the single-deposit ceiling upwards from CZK 300,000 to CZK 350,000. In January 2026 alone the then-three banks handled over 155,000 shared deposits worth nearly CZK 2bn; more than 1.8 million deposits have been made since the deposit function launched in August 2024. KB customers can now also deposit using a digitalised card on a phone or smartwatch.
signals.source_name: Komercni banka press release — 'Ke sdilenym vkladovym bankomatum se pripojuje UniCredit Bank'
signals.implies: Czechia now has TWO competing shared deposit-ATM networks (this one, plus Ceska sporitelna/CSOB/Raiffeisenbank 'Vklad na kartu'), i.e. roughly 2,000 deposit-capable machines and rising volumes. That is sustained demand for cash recyclers/deposit modules, NFC/tokenised card acceptance at the ATM, cross-bank switching and reconciliation, and managed monitoring — Printec cash-automation and managed-services territory.
signals.followup: Identify which banks still lack deposit capability on parts of their estate and quantify the retrofit opportunity.

signals.signal: STANDING, RE-VERIFIED WITH A PRIMARY SOURCE: the rival 'Vklad na kartu' shared deposit service went into full production on 16/09/2025 across the three banks' ATMs, on more than one thousand deposit ATMs nationwide, built with Mastercard and Visa (the banks claim a world first — deposit to your own account at another bank's ATM using the card scheme rails, credited in about 30 minutes). Deposit volumes since: Ceska sporitelna +15% y/y, CSOB +12.5% y/y.
signals.source_name: Ceska sporitelna press release — 'Sporitelna, CSOB a Raiffeisenbank spousti v ostrem provozu na svych bankomatech sluzbu Vklad na kartu'
signals.implies: Card-scheme-rail cash deposit is now a Czech commodity and deposits are growing double-digit — the volume growth forces recycler capacity, cassette logistics and cash-cycle optimisation. Printec recyclers, cash-management/forecasting software and managed cash services all fit.
signals.followup: Ask the three banks what share of their ATM estate is deposit-capable today and what the 2027 retrofit plan is.

signals.entity: MONETA Money Bank / CSOB / Komercni banka (Czech cash-automation estate)
signals.signal: NEW CZECH CASH-AUTOMATION SHIFTS REPORTED IN AUGUST 2026: (a) for the first time in Czech history some ATMs dispense the CZK 5,000 banknote — MONETA Money Bank enabled it on sixteen ATMs spread across the country with at least one per regional capital, replacing the CZK 500 denomination in those cassettes; (b) banks are introducing ATMs with SPLIT cash cassettes able to dispense both Czech koruna and euro from the same machine; (c) coin-deposit machines (mincomaty) are diverging — MONETA plans about twenty more, CSOB is REDUCING them, KB is piloting at a single branch; (d) MONETA now runs more than half its branches with no over-the-counter cash withdrawal or deposit and has introduced a fee for teller cash deposits.
signals.source_name: Fajntip.cz — 'Banky meni vklady a vybery z bankomatu. Cesko ceka neprijemne omezeni'
signals.implies: Denomination re-mixing, multi-currency split cassettes and coin automation are all cash-hardware and cash-cycle-software problems — squarely Printec cash automation/recycler and cash-management-software territory, plus branch transformation as tellers disappear. The CZK/EUR dual-currency ATM trend also pre-positions Czech banks for a future euro path.
signals.likelihood: Medium — aggregator-grade secondary reporting; verify each claim with the bank
signals.followup: Verify the CZK 5,000 dispensing and dual-currency cassette claims directly with MONETA and CSOB press offices before using in a pitch.

signals.entity: Slovenska sporitelna / Tatra banka / VUB banka / CSOB SK / UniCredit Bank CZ+SK
signals.signal: MATERIALLY EXPANDED DATASET vs the 28/07/2026 baseline: as of 17/08/2026 Slovak branch cash desks are being dismantled across all five large banks — Slovenska sporitelna 93 of 128 branches without a cash desk; Tatra banka 48 of 69; CSOB 47 of 120; VUB banka 25 of 121 fully cashless; UniCredit Bank 16 of 47. Banks name the cost of physical cash — security, staff training, guarding, cash-in-transit, vault equipment and machine maintenance — as the driver, and are pushing customers onto ATMs and deposit machines for 24/7 access.
signals.source_name: Techbyte.sk — 'Banky koncia s hotovostou. Ak vam ju treba, poslu vas inam'
signals.implies: Every closed cash desk has to be replaced by a recycler or deposit ATM in the branch lobby, and the stated pain (CIT cost, vault handling, machine maintenance) is exactly the Printec managed-cash-services value proposition. VUB (25/121) and UniCredit (16/47) are the least converted and therefore the largest remaining Slovak retrofit pipelines.
signals.followup: Build a branch-by-branch conversion model for VUB and CSOB SK; lead with total-cost-of-cash rather than hardware price.

signals.signal: Seven Slovak banks now run deposit ATMs — Slovenska sporitelna, VUB, Tatra banka, CSOB, UniCredit Bank, Raiffeisen and Fio banka — for a national estate of roughly 1,000 machines (SLSP and VUB in the hundreds each, the smaller banks in the dozens). Tatra banka alone operates 355 deposit machines handling about 450,000 deposits per month. Deposits are still bank-closed: you can only deposit at your own bank's machine. Slovak banks are actively ANALYSING how to remove the technical barrier so cross-bank deposits become possible, but no implementation date has been set.
signals.source_name: Finsider.sk — 'Vkladomaty maju jednu nevyhodu: vyuzit ich mozu len klienti danej banky. Mohlo by sa to zmenit'
signals.implies: Slovakia is one to two years behind Czechia, which already has two live shared deposit networks. A Slovak shared-deposit scheme would need cross-bank switching, deposit reconciliation, dispute handling and estate-wide recycler capability — a defined, dated integration programme Printec can shape now, while it is still at the analysis stage and no vendor is locked in.
signals.likelihood: Medium — banks confirm analysis but no committed date
signals.followup: Take the Czech 'Vklad na kartu' and KB/MONETA/Air Bank/UniCredit blueprints to the Slovak Banking Association and to SLSP/VUB/Tatra as a ready reference architecture.

signals.signal: NEW MARKET ENTRANT/REBRAND MISSED BY THE BASELINE: Privatbanka, a member of the Penta Investments group and 31 years in the market with a Czech foreign-bank branch for the last eight, was renamed Penta Bank on 18/05/2026 and is repositioning from a private bank into a pan-European retail-capable institution. Since December 2025 it has been building an entirely NEW technology platform; delivered so far are a new website, new internet banking, a new mobile app and DIGITAL ONBOARDING. Strategy is one bank with a modular ecosystem serving several European markets rather than parallel country banks. The management team was rebuilt around the change: Petr Rehak CEO and chairman from 02/01/2026 (replacing Lubos Sevcik after 18 years), Jiri Mizera COO and Tomas Dvorak CFO both appointed 02/03/2026 and both joining the board, plus new heads of HR, marketing and communications in Q1-2026.
signals.source_name: oPeniazoch.sk (openiazoch.zoznam.sk) — 'Smele plany Penty v bankovnictve: Privatbanka sa meni na Penta Bank'; Banky.sk top-management-changes register
signals.implies: A greenfield core/channel platform with a brand-new CEO, COO and CFO and an explicit multi-country expansion plan is the single best-timed Slovak opportunity in this market: digital onboarding/eKYC, AML/KYC and transaction monitoring, card/POS acquiring and HSM/security are all still being chosen, and a bank scaling from private banking to retail will need cash-access arrangements it does not have today.
signals.followup: Get the Penta Bank primary press release from pentabank.sk and approach COO Jiri Mizera on the platform build; confirm which onboarding/eKYC and AML vendors are already selected.

signals.entity: Hungarian government / MNB — free ATM cash-withdrawal allowance
signals.signal: MISSED BY THE BASELINE: from 01/02/2026 the monthly free ATM cash-withdrawal allowance for Hungarian consumers DOUBLED from HUF 150,000 to HUF 300,000 (still capped at two free transactions a month); the enabling provision was published in the Magyar Kozlony at the end of 2025. The 0.9% financial transaction levy still applies above the free allowance. The Hungarian Banking Association publicly opposed the change, arguing the indirect cost to society and the banks exceeds the benefit and that the transaction levy should have been cut instead. Context figures from the MNB's 2025 payment systems report: cash in circulation passed HUF 9,200bn in September 2025, card purchase value is nearly three times the 2019 level, and the VALUE OF CASH DEPOSITS AT MACHINES has more than TRIPLED versus 2019 — ATMs in Hungary have shifted from dispense-only to recirculation.
signals.source_name: hvg.hu — 'Hamarosan uj korszak kezdodik a magyar ATM-eknel'; Ado.hu
signals.implies: Doubling the free allowance raises cash-out volume per ATM and the tripled deposit value proves recycling demand — both drive cassette capacity, cash-cycle optimisation and RECYCLER (cash-in/cash-out) hardware, which is Printec's core cash-automation line. It also raises the cost of cash for banks, strengthening the managed-cash-services pitch.
signals.followup: Get the MNB's Q1/Q2-2026 payment statistics to quantify the post-February volume step-change per ATM.

signals.entity: MBH Bank Nyrt. — technology estate and hiring
signals.signal: PROGRAM, LIVE 31/08/2026: profession.hu returns 74 hits for MBH Bank, of which 68 distinct MBH Bank Nyrt. vacancies were enumerated. Three clusters: (1) a ~13-role IT operations/resilience build — Incidensmenedzser, Problem manager, ITSM folyamatgazda, Rendszerszervezo - ITSM rendszerek, Observability mernok, Halozatuzemeltetesi mernok, Hardver es storage uzemelteto, Virtualizacios uzemelteto, Oracle adatbazis uzemelteto, Tesztkornyezet menedzser, Solution Architect, Adatmernok, Node.js fejleszto; (2) a PLATFORM cluster naming the incumbent systems — 'Arksys rendszerszervezo' (Arksys is the Euronet-owned CARD MANAGEMENT / ATM and POS transaction-switching platform), 'Flexcube Alkalmazas uzemelteto' (Oracle FLEXCUBE core banking), 'Senior alkalmazasuzemelteto - Fraud rendszerek' (fraud systems), and TWO 'Vault' roles (secrets/key management); (3) roughly THIRTY front-line 'Univerzalis tanacsado' branch-advisor vacancies concentrated in small and rural settlements (Hodasz, Szikszo, Bóly, Barcs, Lenti, Pacsa, Balatonboglar, Dunafoldvar, Szigetvar and others) plus several deputy-branch-manager and area-manager roles.
signals.source_name: Profession.hu vacancy search, employer MBH Bank Nyrt.
signals.implies: Two hard commercial facts fall out. First, MBH's card/ATM switching runs on Arksys (Euronet) and its core is Oracle FLEXCUBE — that is competitor-incumbency intelligence Printec can price against and integrate to. Second, MBH is simultaneously staffing branches in exactly the small settlements Act XVIII targets, so its physical small-town build-out is real and continuing. The 13-role IT-operations/observability/incident-management build reads as DORA operational-resilience work and is a managed-services and monitoring opening.
signals.followup: Confirm MBH's Arksys/Euronet contract renewal window; position Printec ATM hardware + managed monitoring against an Arksys-switched estate; approach on DORA-driven ICT service management.

signals.implies: The two largest Czech banks each added ~15 vacancies in a month while continuing to close branch cash desks — capacity is moving from tellers into technology and advisory. Ceska sporitelna's 'Tribe IT Lead - Customer Solutions' is a channels-tribe leadership seat worth tracking.
signals.followup: Re-run the same counter next month; the ChS/CSOB gap versus Raiffeisenbank's flat 51 is the trend to watch.

signals.signal: RARE EXPLICIT ATM-ESTATE ROLE: Fio banka posted 'Administrativni pracovnik/ce na oddeleni Spravy bankomatu' — an administrator in its ATM ADMINISTRATION DEPARTMENT — on 27/08/2026, alongside 'Operator/operatorka - monitoring provozu a podpora' (operations monitoring and support). Fio is one of the seven Slovak deposit-ATM operators and runs its own Czech ATM estate.
signals.source_name: Jobs.cz vacancy listing, Fio banka, a.s.
signals.implies: An ATM administration department that is growing headcount in a market where the big banks are outsourcing is a direct, named self-service buying centre. Fio operates in both Czechia and Slovakia, so one relationship covers two of the three markets in scope.
signals.followup: Identify Fio's ATM hardware vendor and cash-handling model; pitch monitoring/managed services against its in-house team.

signals.entity: Cesko-Slovenska obchodna banka (CSOB SK) + 365.bank + Postova banka
signals.signal: NEW SHARED ATM NETWORK: from 01/07/2026 clients of CSOB, 365.bank and Postova banka can use a COMBINED network of nearly 600 ATMs on their own bank's terms — CSOB contributes 428 machines and 365.bank 176. The previous EUR 200 per-transaction withdrawal cap on cross-bank use was abolished, so customers can withdraw up to their card limit in one transaction. The shared arrangement covers WITHDRAWALS only: CSOB's deposit machines stay restricted to its own clients. This is the first practical consequence of KBC's acquisition of 365.bank (98.45% for EUR 708m, completed 15/01/2026, ~800,000 365.bank clients); full LEGAL consolidation of the two banks was expected in AUTUMN 2026, after which the combined bank would be Slovakia's #2 by client numbers and #3 by loan volume. Daniel Kollar leads both banks.
signals.source_name: Techbyte.sk — 'Tri banky zlucia siet bankomatov'; Teraz.sk on the KBC completion
signals.implies: A ~600-machine estate about to be legally merged is the largest single Slovak ATM rationalisation and refresh decision in the market: duplicate sites will be removed, surviving sites standardised on one platform, and the explicitly UNSOLVED problem is deposit interoperability, which needs recyclers and cross-bank deposit switching. Printec should be in front of the CSOB SK integration programme office now, before the autumn-2026 legal merger sets the target operating model.
signals.followup: Confirm whether the legal merger completed in autumn 2026; obtain the combined estate plan and the deposit-interoperability roadmap.

signals.entity: Tatra banka, a.s. + Narodna banka Slovenska
signals.signal: Tatra banka is one of the 36 payment service providers the ECB selected on 14/07/2026 for the digital euro PILOT, and NBS is one of the 19 national central banks hosting it — making Tatra banka the only Slovak PSP in the pilot. The pilot starts in H2-2027 and runs 12 months on a beta digital euro that will not be legal tender; the ECB will finalise the list of LOCATIONS where participating PSPs offer pilot services later in 2026. First possible issuance is 2029, assuming the digital euro Regulation is adopted in 2026.
signals.source_name: Narodna banka Slovenska — 'ECB oznamila, kto bude testovat pouzivanie digitalneho eura'; ECB digital euro pilot page
signals.implies: The pilot's location-selection step, happening in the REST OF 2026, is where physical acceptance and cash-in/cash-out points get defined — ATMs, POS terminals and onboarding flows. Tatra banka already runs 355 deposit machines. Printec can position digital-euro-capable ATM/POS acceptance, onboarding/eKYC and HSM/key management for the pilot build.
signals.followup: Ask Tatra banka's payments team which channels are in scope for its pilot locations; track the ECB location list publication later in 2026.

signals.signal: NEAR-ZERO FINDING, MEASURED: a Slovakia-wide profesia.sk search on 31/08/2026 returns just TWO live vacancies anywhere in the country whose text contains 'bankomatov' (one in the Bratislava region, one in the Zilina region), against 21 hits for 'AML' and roughly 55 for 'hotovosti'. Board checked: profesia.sk, the dominant Slovak job board. signals.implies: Slovak banks are dismantling cash desks and merging ATM networks WITHOUT building internal ATM teams — the work is being bought in. That is the structural argument for Printec managed self-service services in Slovakia rather than box-selling. The AML count of 21 corroborates the same compliance cycle visible in Czechia.
signals.followup: Escalate profesia.sk to a browser session next run to read the two ATM postings and per-employer counts for SLSP, VUB, Tatra and CSOB SK.

signals.signal: NEAR-TERM CHANNEL DEADLINE: Erste Bank Hungary is retiring its retail NetBank and replacing it with George Web in phases, with completion BY THE END OF SEPTEMBER 2026. The 2026 roadmap set out by Harmati Laszlo, deputy CEO for Retail Banking, adds the 'Hey George' assistant built on an OpenAI model that already powers an internal contact-centre tool ingesting every retail product rule, notice and contract term, and will turn proactive during 2026; plus stocks/fractional shares/ETFs in George and dynamic currency selection at point of sale for FX payments. Two large planned outages in April 2026 took George App and Web, Erste TeleBank, ALL corporate digital channels, instant transfers and SMS services offline simultaneously.
signals.source_name: FinTechZone — '2026-os fokusz az Erste-nel: proaktiv Hey George...'; Erste Bank Hungary system-development notices
signals.implies: Erste HU is mid-migration on its retail digital channel with a September 2026 cut-over, and Harmati Laszlo's mandate — flagged in the baseline as possibly expiring 31/05/2026 — is still visibly running the retail roadmap. Channel migration of this size drags authentication, onboarding/eKYC, self-service integration and fraud monitoring behind it. The April outage scope shows how tightly coupled the estate is, which is a DORA/operational-resilience conversation.
signals.followup: Confirm the George Web cut-over actually completed at end-September 2026 and who now owns Erste HU channels; verify Harmati Laszlo's current title from erstebank.hu.

signals.signal: NEW STRATEGIC CYCLE PLUS A LEADERSHIP GAP: CIB Bank entered a new strategic cycle from 2026 built on platform solutions and AI, adopting group solutions from Intesa Sanpaolo, which has deployed over 150 generative-AI solutions group-wide across commercial efficiency (Robo4Advisor generating ~500,000 investment recommendations a month), operational efficiency (virtual assistants handling 80% of customer conversations automatically) and AI anomaly detection in risk. In 2025 CIB rebuilt its infrastructure on microservices (February) and shipped a Flutter-based mobile app (December) adding card blocking and replacement. Its branch model uses community tables with tablets and 24/7 deposit-capable ATMs. IMPORTANT DERIVED FINDING: the executive who set that 2026 digital retail agenda, Dr. Akos Tamas, deputy CEO for Retail Banking, LEFT CIB and took office at MBH Bank on 01/08/2026 after 12 years running CIB's retail division — so CIB's retail/digital leadership changed hands mid-cycle. Luigi Fuzio remains Chairman and CEO (took office 16/06/2026). CIB shows roughly 16 vacancies on profession.hu.
signals.source_name: FinTechZone — 'Uj strategiai ciklus a CIB Banknal 2026-tol'; digitrendi.hu on the MBH appointment
signals.implies: A brand-new CEO since June 2026 AND the loss of the retail digital leader in August 2026, in the first year of a new strategic cycle, means CIB's retail channel and self-service decisions are being re-made right now. Its stated branch model (tablet-served community tables, 24/7 deposit ATMs) is exactly a Printec branch-transformation and recycler configuration.
signals.followup: Identify CIB's new retail division head and approach in Q4-2026; confirm CIB's deposit-ATM vendor.

signals.signal: ZERO-TO-NEAR-ZERO FINDING, MEASURED: profession.hu, Hungary's main job board, returns 16 hits nationwide for 'ATM' on 31/08/2026, of which only TWO are at banks — OTP Bank's 'Vallalati biztonsagi szakerto' (25/08/2026) and Erste Bank Hungary's 'Penzkezelesi ugyintezo' cash-handling clerk in Szentendre (28/08/2026). Neither is an ATM channel, self-service or cash-automation role. Comparative counts on the same board: 'onkiszolgalo' 42 hits (retail/hospitality, not banking), 'keszpenz' 105, 'csalas' (fraud) 6. signals.source_name: Profession.hu keyword searches; OTP Bank SuccessFactors career site
signals.implies: Hungary is four months from a hard statutory ATM deadline and NO Hungarian bank is hiring ATM or self-service staff. The deployment, installation, cash logistics and operation of the Act XVIII estate is therefore being bought from vendors — the strongest possible argument for a Printec ATM-as-a-service / managed-deployment proposition into OTP, Erste HU and Raiffeisen HU in particular, the three banks that challenged the law and least want to build internal capability.
signals.followup: Ask each Hungarian obligated bank who is physically installing and operating their Act XVIII machines; K&H Bank (38 postings, absent from the baseline entirely) needs its own profile built next run.

signals.entity: Czech banks — ISO 20022 structured addresses and instant SEPA
signals.signal: STATUS OF THE OPEN BASELINE ITEM: the structured-address change is REAL and already partly in force, but earlier than and different from the baseline's framing. Komercni banka's customer guidance states the address-data change for SEPA and foreign payments applies FROM 20/06/2026: the address must be split into structured fields (name, street and number, postcode then city, country as a separate field) and for SEPA the recipient address is optional but, if given, city AND country become mandatory. KB currently CONVERTS addresses to the structured format server-side for MultiCash 3.2x/4.0x users; MultiCash 5.0 will allow direct structured entry with full pain.001.001.09 compatibility. The global culmination remains 14/11/2026, each bank may set its own earlier date, and after that date banks may REJECT non-compliant instructions. Separately, CSOB changes its Czech terms and price list from 01/11/2026 to add INSTANT SEPA (euro) transfers within the EU/EEA, free on most account types and CZK 6 on the Basic Account. NOTE: no formal CNB/CERTIS statement on domestic structured addresses could be found — the change so far bites on cross-border and SEPA traffic, not domestic CERTIS payments.
signals.source_name: Komercni banka customer guidance on structured addresses for SEPA and foreign payments; Mesec.cz on CSOB's 01/11/2026 terms change
signals.implies: A dated, unavoidable payments-message compliance deadline across every Czech bank, plus CSOB adding instant SEPA in euro from 01/11/2026. Any Printec-touched component that carries or enriches payment messages — POS/acquiring, ATM host interfaces, transaction monitoring rules keyed on address/party data — must be structured-address clean by mid-November 2026. It is also a credible door-opener conversation with payments product owners at every Czech bank this autumn.
signals.followup: Confirm whether the CNB has issued any CERTIS-specific structured-address requirement; check each Czech bank's own cut-over date, which may precede 14/11/2026.

signals.entity: Magyar Nemzeti Bank — Payment Systems Report
signals.signal: PUBLICATION GAP / ZERO FINDING: as of 31/08/2026 the MNB's 'Fizetesi rendszer jelentes' (Payment Systems Report) index lists editions only up to 2025 — NO 2026 edition has been published, although the report is normally an annual mid-year publication and is the authoritative source for Hungarian ATM counts, POS terminal counts and qvik volumes. The MNB's 2026 press-release archive likewise carries no ATM, cash-access or qvik release in July or August 2026. The most recent hard ATM figure available therefore remains the 5,688 ATMs at end-March 2026 from the Q1-2026 statistics already in the baseline.
signals.source_name: MNB.hu — Fizetesi rendszer jelentes publication index; MNB 2026 press-release archive
signals.implies: No refreshed national ATM/POS baseline this run. Do not quote a post-March-2026 Hungarian ATM count to a client. The report, when it lands, is the single best proof point for the Act XVIII-driven estate growth and should be picked up the moment it publishes.
signals.followup: Watch mnb.hu/kiadvanyok/jelentesek/fizetesi-rendszer-jelentes and the MNB statistical publication calendar for the 2026 edition and the Q2-2026 payment tables.

(2) REGULATORS — MNB 2026 press-release archive, MNB Payment Systems Report index, MNB banknote news, CNB/CERTIS pages, NBS digital-euro release, ECB digital euro pilot page. (5) LOCAL-LANGUAGE PRESS in Hungarian, Czech and Slovak — techbyte.sk, finsider.sk, fajntip.cz, mesec.cz, penize.cz, privatbankar.hu, hvg.hu, teraz.sk, openiazoch.sk. Deliberate variation this run: went to the consolidated statute rather than press summaries of it, used the Slovak and Czech consumer-finance press (techbyte, finsider, fajntip, mesec) which the baseline had not used, and used profession.hu which the baseline had not used. GENUINE GAPS: no MNB 2026 Payment Systems Report exists yet, so no refreshed national ATM/POS counts for Hungary; no Constitutional Court decision published on the ATM-law complaint; no named successor for Komercni banka's digital board seat; profesia.sk per-employer counts for SLSP/VUB/Tatra/CSOB SK could not be read without a browser; K&H Bank (Hungary, KBC) surfaced with 38 postings but was not profiled in depth and should be a target next run; Slovak leadership register shows nothing new in August, verified rather than assumed.
